name: Aichi

flag.description: A white emblem on a muted red field: the hiragana あいち (Aichi) combined into a rising sun over waves.
flag.symbolism: The sun over waves shows a prefecture facing the Pacific and the world beyond it.

hook: Aichi's white emblem on muted red is あいち (Aichi) drawn as a sun rising over waves; Hiroshima's white emblem on the same red is a crescent.
trivia: Toyota is headquartered in Aichi, in a city renamed Toyota after the company.
